title.narrative: Sports and Physical Activity Impact Assessment Framework in India report

description.narrative:
Funds are required to support the printing of 200 copies of the Sports and Physical Activity Impact Assessment Framework in India report and essential staff travel to attend and support its official launch in March 2026 in Odisha, hosted by the partner institution Kalinga Institute of Social Sciences (KISS). The SAPA framework addresses a critical gap in India’s sport for development ecosystem by providing a structured, evidence-based tool to measure the social and developmental impacts of sport and physical activity across four key domains—health and well-being, education and learning, economic development, and equality and inclusion—at individual, community, and population levels.
The report is scheduled for release in March 2026, and timely printing and staff participation at the launch are essential to ensure effective dissemination, stakeholder engagement, and uptake of this high-value research.
